## Confirmed achievements
- Integration-suite feedback: The largest integration suite changed from approximately 60 minutes to approximately 2 minutes.
- Fewer synchronous calls per event: Summary events removed approximately 1–2 synchronous API calls per relevant event.
- Reads isolated from transactional data: The read representation reduced pressure and blocking on operational data; exact state stays at the authoritative source.
- Modernization with a safe fallback: Progressive accessory-pricing extraction retained legacy behaviour as a stable fallback.

## Projects
- [Platform934](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/platform934/): I wanted my own way to browse my Jellyfin library on mobile, on the web and from the sofa. The TV remote ended up adding a few more tasks.
  implemented: Media core · implemented: TV experience · implemented: Agentic engineering workflow · implemented: API and tool-using agent · in_progress: Cross-device control
- [Platform934 API](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/platform934-api/): A private backend for talking about my library and asking for recommendations or lists. The agent gateway connects those conversations to concrete Jellyfin operations.
  
- [Stream Optimizer](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/stream-optimizer/): Maintaining a media library involves plenty of repetitive work. Stream Optimizer brings together n8n workflows and an FFmpeg worker to automate trailers, normalization and transcoding.
  
- [Devagon Alley](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/devagon-alley/): My apps also needed somewhere to download and update themselves. Devagon Alley is that small private application distribution and update service: access, catalogue, versions and downloads.
  
- [Luna Tartas](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/luna-tartas/): A website for Luna’s handmade gifts: diaper cakes, stationery and personalized details. The catalogue organizes products by type, occasion and recipient.
  
- [Koso](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/koso/): Original things that go from an idea to an object. Koso brings physical and personalized products together in its own store, with 3D printing among the ways to make them.
  
- [Luna Studio](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/luna-studio/): Edit Luna’s catalogue from an app: products, images, inventory and publishing. Luna Studio is the private Flutter backoffice connecting that work to the website.
  
- [AntoñiOS](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/antonios/): A portfolio that grew windows, a terminal and a fictional operating system. I wanted browsing it to feel a little like exploring. You are inside it.
  
- [bio-cli / bio-dev-card](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/bio-cli/): A small professional card to open in the terminal. Node.js and TypeScript, a few prompts and the links at hand.
  

## Architecture cases
- [Vehicle read model](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): A read projection reduced pressure on a legacy path while modernization continued incrementally.
- [Testing infrastructure](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): Successive improvements turned legacy testing friction into reusable patterns and faster feedback.
- [Event summaries](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): Relevant context in summary events reduced synchronous enrichment for affected consumers.
- [Incremental legacy modernization](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): A qualitative framework adjusts intervention to criticality and expected change frequency.
- [Distributed boundaries and pragmatic DDD](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): Two professional simplification cases and a recurring pattern: richer modelling where domain complexity warrants it.
- [Incident-diagnosis agent](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/architecture/): A tool-using workflow connects traceId, telemetry, knowledge, code and reporting; no autonomous remediation.

## AI Lab
- AI for Engineering: Supervised agents for discovery, planning, code and legacy comprehension, implementation, testing, CI diagnosis and technical review.
- AI inside Software / Incident Diagnosis: Orchestration from traceId through telemetry, documented knowledge, code inspection, diagnosis and reporting; without autonomous remediation.
